fix_name: Critical UUID Handling Fix — Tag to UUID Resolution
problem_summary: Tag string (e.g. name#1234) is being passed directly into UUID DB fields (receiver_id, sender_id), causing Postgres error 22P02 invalid input syntax for uuid.
root_cause: API routes expect UUID but frontend now sends tag string.

agents.responsibility: Fix API routes to resolve tag → UUID before DB operations.

tasks.title: Fix POST /api/friends/request
actions: Change request body schema to accept { tag: string } instead of receiverId
Validate tag format using Zod regex: /^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+#[0-9]{4}$/
Query users table WHERE tag = inputTag
If not found → return 404
Extract foundUser.id (UUID)
Use foundUser.id as receiver_id in DB insert
Never pass tag string into UUID column

tasks.title: Fix POST /api/voice-messages
actions: If request body contains tag instead of receiverId:
Resolve tag to user.id first
Reject if user not found
Insert using UUID only
Ensure VoiceMessageSchema expects UUID after resolution

definition_of_done: No tag string ever reaches DB UUID column
Friend request works using tag input
Voice message works using tag input

agents.responsibility: Ensure schemas reflect correct input expectations.

tasks.title: Create TagInputSchema
actions: Define z.string().regex(/^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+#[0-9]{4}$/)
Use safeParse only
Return descriptive 400 on invalid format

tasks.title: Separate ExternalInputSchema vs InternalDBSchema
actions: External API accepts tag
Internal DB logic only uses UUID
Never allow UUID field to receive raw request input

agents.responsibility: Ensure frontend sends correct payload structure.

tasks.title: Update friend request frontend
actions: Send { tag: 'name#1234' } instead of receiverId
Handle 404 user not found error gracefully
Display toast on invalid tag

tasks.title: Update voice message send logic
actions: If sending by tag, call API with tag field
Do not assume UUID in frontend

agents.responsibility: Prevent similar UUID mistakes in future.

tasks.title: Add UUID validation guard
actions: Before any DB insert/update with UUID fields:
Assert typeof id === string
Assert id matches UUID regex
If invalid → throw 400 before DB layer

integration_tests_required: Send friend request using tag → success
Send friend request with invalid tag → 400
Send friend request with non-existent tag → 404
Send voice message using tag → success
stop_condition: Tag-to-UUID resolution implemented, no UUID syntax errors, friend request and voice messaging fully operational.
